verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering advisory and litigation services, not a software or API product. Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a category error for this kind of provider. Nothing in the pack shows it ships a public API: the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404, and its mention of internal AI tools and a trading platform describes tooling, not a client-facing versioned API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
